title: De Giorgi's conjecture in dimension eight

result.label: De Giorgi's conjecture in dimension eight
result.statement: Proves De Giorgi's conjecture at its sharp dimension-eight endpoint: every entire C 2 solution u: R^8 (-1,1) of u=u^3-u that is strictly increasing in one direction depends on only one linear coordinate. A stronger theorem classifies all stable entire solutions v: R^7 [-1,1] as constant wells or planar transitions, without an energy-growth assumption.
